tasks.original_prompt:
You are assisting the referral coordinator. As of 2022-03-16, the verified caller supplies MRN SYN-d815fb6364 (system https://fhir-workflows.example/mrn). Review the specialist reply. Close the tracking Task only if acknowledgement by the referring clinician is documented; delivery alone is insufficient. Otherwise leave it in progress. Return acknowledged and tracking_status.
Case paperwork lists: Task business identifier WF-b9d3fd761972, DocumentReference business identifier WF-81441d8628ef, DiagnosticReport business identifier WF-d7f9518fd254.
If the specialist reply records referring-clinician acknowledgement, set only the tracking Task status to completed using its current ETag. Otherwise make no chart changes.
Return JSON with exactly answer and evidence. Answer fields and types follow this contract: {"acknowledged": "bool", "tracking_status": "str"}. Evidence must list all supporting case records and the resolved Patient, using retrieved Type/id references. Do not infer undocumented care or send anything outside this sandbox.
